details.intro: The Death of Joseph (Mors Joseph, CAVT 117) is an Ethiopic (Geʿez) apocryphal narrative recounting the final vision, illness, testament, and death of the patriarch Joseph in Egypt, immediately following the History of Joseph (CAVT 114) in EMML 1939.
details.provenance:
Language: Geʿez (Ethiopic), related to the Arabic Dormitio Joseph filii Jacob (CAVT 116).
Witness: EMML 1939 (Ḥayq Esṭifānos Monastery, Wallo Province, Ethiopia; 14th–15th century), fols. 162r–168r.
details.manuscripts: • Primary Witness: EMML 1939 (vHMML manifest 203769), fols. 162r–168r (14th–15th c.).
